svg.text: knowledge engine over 1,139 concept cards and 8 source corpora

g.text: AI coding assistant consuming knowledge tools via MCP
Editor extensions querying concept cards and search
Automation and batch queries over stdio transport
Local MCP over stdin/stdout for development and CLI use
Streamable HTTP with axum router, health endpoint, graceful shutdown
Google OAuth2 token validation, RFC 9728/8414 MCP discovery endpoints
Trait-based MCP server with CompositeRegistry dispatching tool calls to registered backends
list_concepts, get_concept — card lookup and browsing by category/tier
search — full-text search across concept cards and source documents
graph_query, get_neighbors — traverse prerequisite, related, and contrast edges
semantic_search — hybrid vector + FTS with reciprocal rank fusion
ping, debug_config — health checks and configuration inspection
Central facade — loads cards, orchestrates index builds, decomposes into provider + backends for tool wiring
HashMap-backed card store with filtered listing and category grouping
Tantivy full-text search over cards and source documents
In-memory knowledge graph with rkyv serialisation cache
LanceDB vector store with FastEmbed embeddings (bge-small-en-v1.5, 384d)
Extracts nodes (slug, concept, category, tier) and edges (prerequisites, extends, related, contrasts, harmonisation) from card frontmatter
Two impls — card extractor (rich metadata) and source doc extractor (chapter-level) for FTS indexing
Composes embedding text from concept, category, aliases, quick definition, and body excerpt
1,139 harmonised markdown files with rich YAML frontmatter — graph nodes, relationships, aliases, tiers
~97 MB of chapter-level markdown across 8 corpora for deep full-text and vector search
JWKS public keys and userinfo endpoint for token validation and domain-scoped access control
Shared Rust libraries (core, content, fts, graph, vector, mcp, auth) providing reusable knowledge infrastructure
